claim: At RL step 100 the plain samples that do not open deliberatively are unswitched plain-base answers, so on the same problem the cued step-100 model is right far more often than they are.
After 100 RL steps the shift is graded and present in every sample, so the step-100 cue samples beat the non-deliberative plain samples by little (D1 in [-0.10, 0.12]).
